entities.summary: Rebekka Bakken is a Norwegian singer, songwriter and music producer who is often associated with jazz, although she refuses to characterise herself as a jazz musician. Her voice reaches over three octaves. Rebekka Bakken was a composers & musicians from Lier (b. 1970-04-04, Lier). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
